welcome.text: Welcome to my corner of the bookshop. What would you like to ask?

choices.question: Could you tell me about yourself?
Where can I see your illustrations?
Are there short stories I can read?

stories.text: You'll find Rat and Facing Winter in the reading room. Take a seat and choose a story.

art.text: My illustrations are displayed in frames along the gallery wall. You can choose any frame for a closer look.

contact.text: You can reach me at hfjballard@gmail.com. My monthly newsletter shares book news, stories and upcoming events. You can manage your newsletter preference in My Library.
